versions.changelog:
Version 1.3.0

- Added mandatory privacy notice and user consent flow before any data collection, emphasizing local data storage and user control.
- Strengthened data minimization: only collects information actively provided by the user, with no unsolicited sensitive questions.
- Shortened and clarified skill description, with updated language routing logic.
- Updated documentation structure, removing HTML demo and out-of-date files; added new README and requirements for easier setup.
- Enhanced privacy warnings in data visualization export (dashboard HTML).
- Improved onboarding reminders for returning users regarding local data storage.

**Bilingual support & language detection added for seamless Chinese/English experience:**

- Added full bilingual (中文/English) support for all workflow steps, onboarding, feedback, empathy, and visualizations.
- Introduced automated language detection at session start, routing all logic and reference files based on user language.
- Added new `references-en/` directory: all analysis, empathy, and medical reference files now available in English.
- Updated workflow and SKILL description to document language branching and multi-language signal detection.
- Ensured all user-facing outputs, dashboard labels, recommendations, and empathy patterns are delivered in the correct language.

**Dashboard demonstration and core reference updates.**

- Added interactive HTML demo dashboard and sample data for visualization preview.
- Updated analysis engine, empathy guide, life stages, medical standards, and user profile references for improved clarity and support.
- Enhanced documentation to clarify workflow and system logic, ensuring accuracy, empathetic interactions, and safety standards.

Menstrual Health Tracker 1.0.0

- Initial release with multi-dimensional menstrual health tracking for all life stages (pre-menarche, menstruating, TTC, pregnant, postpartum, perimenopause, postmenopause)
- Supports personalized user profiling, adaptive tracking, and scientific, empathetic interactions
- Cycle and symptom logging, structured daily logs, and historical data import
- Predictive analytics, pattern discovery, and cycle forecasting based on user data
- Interactive HTML dashboard visualization with health-themed color schemes
- Evidence-based guidance, with strict safety boundaries and tiered suggestions
- Local data storage prioritizing privacy and user control
